text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto, who had been on the heavier 
side, asked me to check the results of her 
diet.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Phew... phew... Sorry to keep... you... 
waiting...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
L-Look, please... please look... I'm 
g-getting closer to my original weight.
choice_data_list: Why do you look so exhausted!?
Why are you so worn out!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah... I'm a bit hungry... Though I 
feel all floaty and light on my feet~

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Looks like taking the plunge and fasting 
actually paid off, whew...
choice_data_list:
You're losing all the important nutrients 
too!
Even the essential nutrients are gone!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-Now that you mention it, rather than 
feeling lighter, it feels more like my 
strength is gone...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah-wawa, was I wrong by any chance...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san! Is there really no salvation 
at all~~?!

By prescribing a proper diet and 
weight-loss exercises, Meisho Doto was 
able to diet the healthy way.
